mapping.title: Timeline mapping
mapping.intro: Relate the recording's media time to the match time. Enter times as mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.
mapping.noDuration: The recording's length could not be read. Enter where the media ends.
mapping.invalidTime: Enter a time as mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.
mapping.endBeforeStart: The media end must be after the media start.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.empty: No recordings have been uploaded yet.
recordings.loadFailed: The recordings could not be loaded.

add.title: Add recordings
add.dropZone: Drop video files here or choose them.
add.notVideo: {{file}} is not a video file. Only video files are accepted.
add.journalUnavailable: This browser cannot keep the upload record, so an upload cannot be resumed after a reload.

queue.title: Uploads
queue.duplicate: This file seems to be already uploaded or uploading for this match.
queue.mappingNeeded: Set the timeline mapping to complete this upload.

pending.title: Pending uploads
pending.abandonNote: If you abandon this upload, it is forgotten in this browser and the platform discards the stored parts when the upload expires.
pending.expired: The upload session expired and the platform discards the stored parts. Start again with the same file.
pending.notPermitted: You are no longer permitted to upload this recording. You can only abandon the upload.

signOut.title: Sign out while uploading?
signOut.body: An upload is still transferring. Signing out stops it and deletes this browser's record of your uploads. The platform discards the stored parts when the upload expires.

state.needsFile: Choose the file again to continue

reason.retriesExhausted: Some parts could not be sent. Parts already stored are kept.
reason.storageUnavailable: The recording storage is not available.
reason.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
reason.runningElsewhere: The upload is running in another tab.
reason.objectMismatch: The stored recording does not match the file.
reason.integrityUnavailable: The platform could not verify the stored recording.
reason.partsIncomplete: The platform is missing parts of the recording. Transfer them again.
reason.partMismatch: A stored part does not match the file. Transfer it again.
reason.fileMismatch: This is not the file that was selected before.

failure.tooLarge: The recording is larger than the platform accepts.
failure.unsupportedType: The platform does not accept this type of recording.
failure.other: The upload could not be started.
